name: 77505 · Pasadena, TX
findings: ZIP 77505 (Pasadena) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77505 (Pasadena) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77505 (Pasadena) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
